note: The decoders. Learn these few and you can gist words you were never taught — that's the point. Each meaning-class has its own colour, and that colour is the same everywhere in the app, so a word's colours tell you its grammar at a glance. Per data/ary/blueprint.md: produce the affixes, recognize the roots, never try to build the patterns.

morphemes.gloss: he / it — you'll mostly just hear this
not — it wraps around the verb
going to / will (put it before the verb)
turns a statement into a yes/no question
the word's core meaning lives in its consonants. You won't build these, but spotting the skeleton helps you guess an unheard word — k·t·b words are about writing, k·l about eating.
